messages:
maria: Quick sync: experiment to tighten pricing page funnel this month. Three coordinated changes: compact FAQ (5 q's), emotion-forward tier labels for SMB, and an inline micro-estimator popover (no lead capture on first pass). Goal = cleaner copy, +0.4pp conv, and fewer pre-sales threads. Launch window: Tue 09:00 PT behind flag `pricing_compact_v2`.

owen: Love it. For tier labels let's test 'Launch, Growth, Enterprise' vs 'Team, Business, Scale' — two arms only. Keep the tier benefit bullets to 3 words each.

li: Copy approach: use plain language, drop legalese, add a single example per tier (e.g., "10 devs, 200k tokens/mo -> $X"). I'll hand the FAQ draft by Monday noon. Also thinking of a tiny tooltip that surfaces the per-token math.

maria: @li good. Also add a 1-line "how pricing maps to usage" for accessibility readers.

dev-bot: Preflight note: inline popover should lazy-load and reuse existing estimator endpoint `/api/estimate-v1`. Feature flag: `pricing_popover_v1`. Events: `pricing:popover_open`, `pricing:estimate_run`.

own: Analytics: please instrument `experiment_key=pricing_compact_v2` and send variant id with pageview. Track conversions to trial start and support threads with tag "pricing". Baseline conv = 3.6%. Target +0.4pp.

maria: Routing/lead plan: for this first run we will NOT capture leads in the popover. But if user clicks "Talk to sales" from the popover, open a small modal that pre-fills seats and estimated ARR and posts to `/api/inbound-lead`. sales-ops, confirm AE routing rules?

sales-ops: Confirmed: inbound leads with estimated_arr >= 25k -> sales-inbound queue, else -> nurture-sdr. Include `lead_source=pricing_popover` in payload. Also add `priority: high` if user selected "enterprise support" checkbox.

li: UX note: keep the popover to 3 inputs (seats, average tokens/month/person, billing cadence). Default example values should be smart: seats=5, tokens=50k.

dev-bot: Preview build: https://preview.redwood/pricing-compact-2960012345 (flag on). Visual QA done.

own: Experiment details: run for 14 days, holdout = current pricing page. Primary metric = trial-start rate. Secondary = estimator engagement and support tickets. Also monitor tier selection distribution.

maria: Post-launch ops: set up a short retro doc and a Slack webhook to post daily experiment cadence (AM snapshot). If we see >10% estimator starts but zero conversions, we can quick-iterate copy.

sales-ops: One ask: include `user_country` and `consent_state` in the lead payload for compliance.

li: I'll finalize copy and CTA microcopy for the popover ("Estimate cost", "Talk to sales", "Start free trial"). Draft by EOD today.

own: Good. I'll schedule the feature-flag rollout and wire metrics. Soft launch Tue 09:00 PT behind `pricing_compact_v2` with 25% traffic. Thanks all :rocket:
